manifest.name: The Public Domain Universe
manifest.author: EWF 9000
manifest.description: Nine promotions built from history, myth and fiction published before 1929, reimagined as a modern wrestling world. Each is run a different way.

promotions.name: WHW
promotions.blurb: The giant. Publicly traded, family friendly, and run for the shareholders. Emperors and presidents in sold-out stadiums.

promotions.name: PDW
promotions.blurb: The challenger. Founded by a fan for the fans who rate matches: history, myth and old fiction in one locker room.

promotions.name: OCW
promotions.blurb: Wrestling as sport. Gods and heroes, long matches, tournaments and clean results.

promotions.name: PDP
promotions.blurb: The outlaws. Gothic horror after midnight: violent, cheap and beloved by its crowd.

promotions.name: TTT
promotions.blurb: The underdog. Folk heroes and fairy tales on the county-fair circuit, building what the big companies throw away.

promotions.name: NMW
promotions.blurb: The startup with the blank cheque. Two megastars, a few names and a locker room of hungry unknowns.

promotions.name: LDD
promotions.blurb: The lucha spectacle. Feathered serpents, midnight ghosts and ten-man chaos, with a sponsor on every turnbuckle.

promotions.name: LTA
promotions.blurb: The oldest company in the world. Liberators, emperors and their heirs, wrestling clean and waiting their turn.

promotions.name: KJP
promotions.blurb: All women, all speed. Four factions, stiff strikes and a merchandise table longer than the ring.
